args: .data.repository.pullRequest | ((.timelineItems.nodes // []) | last // {}) as $event | "state=" + (.state // ""), "merged=" + (.merged | tostring), "queued=" + (.isInMergeQueue | tostring), "reason=" + (($event.reason // "") | tojson | .[1:-1]), "event=" + (($event.id // "") | if test("^[A-Za-z0-9_+/=-]{0,256}$") then . else "" end)
